title: The Indigo Shadow Menders
description: At the Feast of Repaired Things, two tailors stitch an ibex’s torn shadow with saffron thread while the village looks on.
alt: Two tailors sew a split in an ibex’s indigo shadow with yellow thread on the sunlit paving of a festival courtyard.
pairing: The Feast of Repaired Things × tailors who stitch torn shadows
